facts.summary: Phase 1 trial discontinued after Grade 3 bilirubin elevations · Phase 1 · SEP-786 in hypoparathyroidism · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Septerna Announces Discontinuation of SEP-786 Phase 1 Clinical Trial and Plans to Advance Next-Generation Oral Small Molecule PTH1R Agonist
evidence.safety: Septerna’s decision follows the observation of two unanticipated severe (Grade 3) events of elevated unconjugated bilirubin in the MAD portion of the Phase 1 trial
evidence.program_discontinued: today announced its decision to discontinue the Phase 1 single- and multiple-ascending dose (SAD/MAD) clinical trial of SEP-786
